about: Scoreboard for Don's betting bot. Every selection is recorded as a level 10 single so the two sources can be compared fairly: 'rules' are Don's two rules (both teams to score, and over/under 2.5 goals), 'confidence' are Claude's own most confident picks. 'in_picks' says whether the selection also went into picks.json for the bot. result is null until settled, then won, lost or void.
